name: wonnyy-amadeus
description: Local-first AI-native knowledge and research workspace

scripts.dev:desktop: wait-on tcp:3000 && cross-env ELECTRON_START_URL=http://localhost:3000 node electron/launch.cjs
scripts.test: node --experimental-strip-types --test electron/*.test.cjs electron/ai/*.test.cjs electron/ai/providers/*.test.cjs lib/*.test.cjs features/chat/*.test.cjs
scripts.format:integration: prettier --write "features/**/*.{ts,tsx,cjs,css}" "electron/ai/**/*.cjs" electron/main.cjs electron/preload.cjs types/ai.ts types/electron.d.ts components/app-shell.tsx components/chat-panel.tsx components/top-bar.tsx "scripts/*chat*.cjs" scripts/electron-smoke-main.cjs
scripts.format:check: prettier --check "features/**/*.{ts,tsx,cjs,css}" "electron/ai/**/*.cjs" electron/main.cjs electron/preload.cjs types/ai.ts types/electron.d.ts components/app-shell.tsx components/chat-panel.tsx components/top-bar.tsx "scripts/*chat*.cjs" scripts/electron-smoke-main.cjs
